<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Menu Scanner</title>
  <style>
    /* ── Reset & base ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --ink:        #1a1a18;
      --ink-2:      #4a4a44;
      --ink-3:      #8a8a82;
      --paper:      #faf9f6;
      --paper-2:    #f2f0eb;
      --paper-3:    #e8e5de;
      --rule:       #dedad2;
      --accent:     #c84b31;     /* editorial red */
      --accent-dk:  #a33a22;
      --amber:      #b45309;
      --amber-bg:   #fef3c7;
      --amber-bd:   #fbbf24;
      --green:      #166534;
      --green-bg:   #dcfce7;
      --green-bd:   #86efac;
      --blue:       #1e40af;
      --blue-bg:    #dbeafe;
      --blue-bd:    #93c5fd;
      --radius:     6px;
      --shadow:     0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
    }

    html { font-size: 16px; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif;
      background: var(--paper);
      color: var(--ink);
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 3rem 1rem 5rem;
    }

    /* ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .page {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ── Masthead ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .masthead {
      text-align: center;
      border-top: 3px solid var(--ink);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
      padding: 1.25rem 0 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .masthead-kicker {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: .4rem;
    }
    .masthead h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .masthead-sub {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      margin-top: .5rem;
    }

    /* ── Upload zone ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .upload-section { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

    .drop-zone {
      position: relative;
      border: 1.5px dashed var(--paper-3);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: var(--paper-2);
      padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color .18s, background .18s;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .drop-zone:hover,
    .drop-zone.drag-over {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: #fdf6f4;
    }
    .drop-zone input[type=file] {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    }
    .drop-icon {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      margin: 0 auto .75rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
    }
    .drop-title {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .drop-hint {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .75rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      margin-top: .3rem;
    }

    /* ── Preview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .preview-wrap {
      position: relative;
      display: none;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--paper-3);
      max-height: 320px;
    }
    .preview-wrap img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 320px;
      object-fit: contain;
    }
    .preview-clear {
      position: absolute;
      top: .5rem; right: .5rem;
      width: 26px; height: 26px;
      background: rgba(26,26,24,.7);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: .85rem;
      line-height: 26px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .preview-clear:hover { background: var(--accent); }

    /* ── Dietary restrictions input ──────────────────────────────── */
    .dietary-section {
      display: none;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .dietary-section.visible { display: block; }
    .dietary-label {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      margin-bottom: .35rem;
      display: block;
    }
    .dietary-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: .5rem .65rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .84rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--ink);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color .18s;
    }
    .dietary-input:focus { border-color: var(--amber-bd); }
    .dietary-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); }
    .dietary-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: .3rem;
      margin-top: .4rem;
    }
    .dietary-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .25rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .18rem .5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--amber-bg);
      color: var(--amber);
      border: 1px solid var(--amber-bd);
    }
    .dietary-tag button {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--amber);
      font-size: .8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      line-height: 1;
      opacity: .7;
    }
    .dietary-tag button:hover { opacity: 1; }
    .dietary-clear-all {
      display: none;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      margin-top: .3rem;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    .dietary-clear-all:hover { color: var(--ink-2); }
    .dietary-clear-all.visible { display: inline; }
    .dietary-limit-msg {
      display: none;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-top: .3rem;
      margin-left: .25rem;
    }
    .dietary-limit-msg.visible { display: inline; }

    /* ── Scan button ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .scan-btn {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      padding: .85rem 1rem;
      background: var(--ink);
      color: var(--paper);
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .88rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .18s;
    }
    .scan-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent); }
    .scan-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

    /* ── Loader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .loader {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .75rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }
    .loader.visible { display: flex; }
    .spinner {
      width: 18px; height: 18px;
      border: 2px solid var(--rule);
      border-top-color: var(--ink);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin .7s linear infinite;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    /* ── Error banner ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .error-banner {
      display: none;
      background: #fef2f2;
      border: 1px solid #fca5a5;
      color: #991b1b;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: .75rem 1rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .84rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }
    .error-banner.visible { display: block; }

    /* ── Results section ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .results-header {
      display: none;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
      padding-bottom: .4rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .results-header.visible { display: flex; }
    .results-title {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .results-count {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
    }

    /* ── Item card ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .item-card {
      padding: 1.1rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    .item-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .item-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: .3rem;
    }
    .item-name {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
    }

    .item-badges {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: .3rem;
      margin-bottom: .45rem;
    }

    .badge {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .15rem .5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    .badge-amber  { background: var(--amber-bg);  color: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber-bd); }
    .badge-green  { background: var(--green-bg);  color: var(--green); border-color: var(--green-bd); }
    .badge-blue   { background: var(--blue-bg);   color: var(--blue);  border-color: var(--blue-bd); }

    .item-desc {
      font-size: .9rem;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin-bottom: .55rem;
    }

    /* ── Ingredients row ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .item-meta {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .item-meta strong {
      color: var(--ink-2);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ── Obscure notes (expandable) ───────────────────────────────── */
    .obscure-toggle {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .25rem;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      margin-top: .4rem;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-decoration-style: dotted;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
    }
    .obscure-toggle .arr { transition: transform .18s; display: inline-block; }
    .obscure-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .arr { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    .obscure-list {
      display: none;
      margin-top: .45rem;
      padding: .6rem .75rem;
      background: var(--paper-2);
      border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;
    }
    .obscure-list.open { display: block; }
    .obscure-list li {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      list-style: none;
      padding: .2rem 0;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .obscure-list li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

    /* ── Card entrance animation ─────────────────────────────────── */
    @keyframes cardIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .item-card {
      animation: cardIn .32s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.1) both;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .item-card { animation: none; }
    }

    /* ── Empty state ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .empty-state {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .85rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
    }

    /* ── Edit button ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .edit-btn {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .75rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      margin-left: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .edit-btn:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* ── Star review button ────────────────────────────────────── */
    .star-btn {
      font-size: .9rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .star-btn:hover { color: var(--amber); }
    .star-btn.has-review { color: var(--amber); }

    /* ── Review modal ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #reviewModal {
      position: fixed; inset: 0;
      display: none;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      z-index: 2000;
    }
    .review-box {
      background: var(--paper);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
      max-width: 420px;
      width: 90%;
    }
    .review-item-name {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-2);
      margin-bottom: .75rem;
    }
    .review-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: .25rem;
      margin-bottom: .75rem;
    }
    .review-stars span {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--rule);
      transition: color .12s;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .review-stars span.filled { color: var(--amber); }
    .review-stars span:hover,
    .review-stars span.hover { color: var(--amber); }
    .review-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      padding: .5rem .65rem;
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .84rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--ink);
      outline: none;
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 3rem;
      transition: border-color .18s;
    }
    .review-textarea:focus { border-color: var(--amber-bd); }
    .review-counter {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      text-align: right;
      margin-top: .2rem;
      margin-bottom: .75rem;
    }
    .review-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .75rem;
    }
    .review-remove {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      margin-top: .5rem;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    .review-remove:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    /* ── Edit form (inline) ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .item-card.edit-mode {
      background: var(--paper-2);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .edit-form {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: .65rem;
    }
    .edit-field {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: .25rem;
    }
    .edit-label {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .edit-form textarea.dietary-input {
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 3.5rem;
    }
    .edit-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .75rem;
      margin-top: .25rem;
    }
    .edit-save {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .4rem .85rem;
      background: var(--ink);
      color: var(--paper);
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .18s;
    }
    .edit-save:hover { background: var(--accent); }
    .edit-cancel {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .edit-cancel:hover { color: var(--ink-2); }

    /* ── Scan block separator ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .scan-block + .scan-block {
      border-top: 2px solid var(--rule);
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* ── Scan block header ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .scan-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .75rem;
      padding-bottom: .75rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      margin-bottom: .75rem;
    }
    .scan-thumb {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .scan-meta {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .78rem;
      color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    .scan-toggle {
      font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: .72rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .scan-toggle:hover { color: var(--ink-2); }
    .scan-delete {
      font-size: .8rem;
      color: var(--ink-3);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .scan-delete:hover { color: var(--accent); }
    .add-item-btn {

<script>
  const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:8000';

  // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let currentUser = null;
  const loginScreen  = document.getElementById('loginScreen');
  const loginForm    = document.getElementById('loginForm');
  const loginUsername = document.getElementById('loginUsername');
  const loginPassword = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
  const loginConfirm = document.getElementById('loginConfirm');
  const loginError   = document.getElementById('loginError');
  const loginSubmit  = document.getElementById('loginSubmit');
  const loginToggle  = document.getElementById('loginToggle');
  const pageEl       = document.querySelector('.page');

  let isCreateMode = false;

  function hashPassword(pw) {
    let hash = 5381;
    for (let i = 0; i < pw.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) ^ pw.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = hash & hash; // keep 32-bit int
    }
    return String(hash >>> 0);
  }

  function getUsers() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('menu_scanner_users') || '[]'); } catch { return []; }
  }
  function saveUsers(users) {
    localStorage.setItem('menu_scanner_users', JSON.stringify(users));
  }

  function showLoginError(msg) { loginError.textContent = msg; }
  function clearLoginError() { loginError.innerHTML = ' '; }

  loginToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    isCreateMode = !isCreateMode;
    loginConfirm.style.display = isCreateMode ? '' : 'none';
    loginSubmit.textContent = isCreateMode ? 'Create account' : 'Sign in';
    loginToggle.textContent = isCreateMode
      ? 'Already have an account? Sign in'
      : "Don't have an account? Create one";
    clearLoginError();
  });

  loginForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      clearLoginError();
      const username = loginUsername.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const password = loginPassword.value;
      const users = getUsers();

      if (isCreateMode) {
        if (username.length < 3) { showLoginError('Username must be at least 3 characters'); return; }
        if (password.length < 6) { showLoginError('Password must be at least 6 characters'); return; }
        if (password !== loginConfirm.value) { showLoginError('Passwords do not match'); return; }
        if (users.some(u => u.username === username)) { showLoginError('Username already taken'); return; }
        const passwordHash = hashPassword(password);
        users.push({ username, passwordHash });
        saveUsers(users);
        loginSuccess(username);
      } else {
        const user = users.find(u => u.username === username);
        if (!user) { showLoginError('Username not found'); return; }
        const passwordHash = hashPassword(password);
        if (user.passwordHash !== passwordHash) { showLoginError('Incorrect password'); return; }
        loginSuccess(username);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showLoginError(err.message);
    }
  });

  function loginSuccess(username) {
    currentUser = username;
    sessionStorage.setItem('menu_scanner_session', username);
    loginScreen.style.display = 'none';
    pageEl.style.display = '';
    initApp();
  }

  // Check for existing session on load
  (function checkSession() {
    const session = sessionStorage.getItem('menu_scanner_session');
    const users = getUsers();
    if (session && users.some(u => u.username === session)) {
      currentUser = session;
      loginScreen.style.display = 'none';
      pageEl.style.display = '';
    } else {
      loginScreen.style.display = '';
      pageEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
  })();

  document.getElementById('signOutLink').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    sessionStorage.removeItem('menu_scanner_session');
    location.reload();
  });

  // ── Reviews store ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  let reviews = {};
  const reviewModal = document.getElementById('reviewModal');

  function loadReviews() {
    try { reviews = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('menu_scanner_reviews_' + currentUser) || '{}'); } catch { reviews = {}; }
  }
  function saveReviews() {
    localStorage.setItem('menu_scanner_reviews_' + currentUser, JSON.stringify(reviews));
  }
  function reviewKey(scanId, itemName) {
    return scanId + '|' + (itemName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function openReviewModal(item, scanId, cardEl) {
    const key = reviewKey(scanId, item.name);
    const existing = reviews[key] || null;
    let selectedRating = existing ? existing.rating : 0;

    reviewModal.innerHTML = '';
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'review-box';

    const nameEl = document.createElement('p');
    nameEl.className = 'review-item-name';
    nameEl.textContent = item.name || 'Unnamed item';
    box.appendChild(nameEl);

    const starsRow = document.createElement('div');
    starsRow.className = 'review-stars';
    const starSpans = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const s = document.createElement('span');
      s.textContent = i <= selectedRating ? '\u2605' : '\u2606';
      if (i <= selectedRating) s.classList.add('filled');
      s.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        starSpans.forEach((sp, idx) => {
          sp.classList.toggle('hover', idx < i);
          sp.textContent = idx < i ? '\u2605' : '\u2606';
        });
      });
      s.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedRating = i;
        starSpans.forEach((sp, idx) => {
          sp.classList.toggle('filled', idx < i);
          sp.textContent = idx < i ? '\u2605' : '\u2606';
        });
      });
      starSpans.push(s);
      starsRow.appendChild(s);
    }
    starsRow.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      starSpans.forEach((sp, idx) => {
        sp.classList.remove('hover');
        sp.classList.toggle('filled', idx < selectedRating);
        sp.textContent = idx < selectedRating ? '\u2605' : '\u2606';
      });
    });
    box.appendChild(starsRow);

    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.className = 'review-textarea';
    textarea.placeholder = 'Write a short review (optional)';
    textarea.maxLength = 200;
    textarea.value = existing ? existing.review || '' : '';
    box.appendChild(textarea);

    const counter = document.createElement('div');
    counter.className = 'review-counter';
    counter.textContent = textarea.value.length + ' / 200';
    textarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
      counter.textContent = textarea.value.length + ' / 200';
    });
    box.appendChild(counter);

    const actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'review-actions';

    const saveBtn = document.createElement('button');
    saveBtn.className = 'edit-save';
    saveBtn.type = 'button';
    saveBtn.textContent = 'Save';
    saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (selectedRating === 0) return;
      reviews[key] = { rating: selectedRating, review: textarea.value.trim(), timestamp: Date.now() };
      saveReviews();
      const starBtn = cardEl.querySelector('.star-btn');
      if (starBtn) { starBtn.textContent = '\u2605'; starBtn.classList.add('has-review'); }
      reviewModal.style.display = 'none';
    });
    actions.appendChild(saveBtn);

    const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
    cancelBtn.className = 'edit-cancel';
    cancelBtn.type = 'button';
    cancelBtn.textContent = 'Cancel';
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { reviewModal.style.display = 'none'; });
    actions.appendChild(cancelBtn);

    box.appendChild(actions);

    if (existing) {
      const removeLink = document.createElement('button');
      removeLink.className = 'review-remove';
      removeLink.type = 'button';
      removeLink.textContent = 'Remove review';
      removeLink.addEventListener('click', () => {
        delete reviews[key];
        saveReviews();
        const starBtn = cardEl.querySelector('.star-btn');
        if (starBtn) { starBtn.textContent = '\u2606'; starBtn.classList.remove('has-review'); }
        reviewModal.style.display = 'none';
      });
      box.appendChild(removeLink);
    }

    reviewModal.appendChild(box);
    reviewModal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  const dropZone    = document.getElementById('dropZone');
  const fileInput   = document.getElementById('fileInput');
  const previewWrap = document.getElementById('previewWrap');
  const preview     = document.getElementById('preview');
  const clearBtn    = document.getElementById('clearBtn');
  const scanBtn     = document.getElementById('scanBtn');
  const loader      = document.getElementById('loader');
  const loaderText  = document.getElementById('loaderText');
  const errorBanner = document.getElementById('errorBanner');
  const resultsSection = document.getElementById('resultsSection');
  const resultsHeader = document.getElementById('resultsHeader');
  const resultsCount  = document.getElementById('resultsCount');
  const results     = document.getElementById('results');

  const dietarySection  = document.getElementById('dietarySection');
  const dietaryInput    = document.getElementById('dietaryInput');
  const dietaryTags     = document.getElementById('dietaryTags');
  const dietaryClearAll = document.getElementById('dietaryClearAll');

  const lightbox    = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');

  // ── Confirm-delete modal helper ─────────────────────────────────
  const confirmModal = document.getElementById('confirmModal');
  const confirmMsg   = confirmModal.querySelector('.confirm-msg');
  const confirmYes   = confirmModal.querySelector('.confirm-yes');
  const confirmNo    = confirmModal.querySelector('.confirm-no');

  function confirmDelete(message) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      confirmMsg.textContent = message;
      confirmModal.style.display = 'flex';
      function cleanup() {
        confirmYes.removeEventListener('click', onYes);
        confirmNo.removeEventListener('click', onNo);
        confirmModal.style.display = 'none';
      }
      function onYes() { cleanup(); resolve(true); }
      function onNo()  { cleanup(); resolve(false); }
      confirmYes.addEventListener('click', onYes);
      confirmNo.addEventListener('click', onNo);
    });
  }
  lightbox.addEventListener('click', () => { lightbox.style.display = 'none'; lightboxImg.src = ''; });
  function openLightbox(src) { lightboxImg.src = src; lightbox.style.display = 'flex'; }

  const uploadPanel      = document.getElementById('uploadPanel');
  const topTriggerWrap   = document.getElementById('topTriggerWrap');
  const bottomTriggerWrap = document.getElementById('bottomTriggerWrap');
  const topTriggerBtn    = document.getElementById('topTriggerBtn');
  const bottomTriggerBtn = document.getElementById('bottomTriggerBtn');

  let activeTrigger = null; // 'top' | 'bottom' | null

  const LABEL_OPEN = '\u2190 Back to menus';
  const LABEL_CLOSED = '\u002b Scan another menu';

  function updateTriggerLabels(panelOpen) {
    const label = panelOpen ? LABEL_OPEN : LABEL_CLOSED;
    topTriggerBtn.textContent = label;
    bottomTriggerBtn.textContent = label;
  }

  function openPanel(which) {
    if (activeTrigger === which) { closePanel(); return; }
    const wrap = which === 'top' ? topTriggerWrap : bottomTriggerWrap;
    const otherWrap = which === 'top' ? bottomTriggerWrap : topTriggerWrap;
    wrap.after(uploadPanel);
    uploadPanel.style.display = '';
    activeTrigger = which;
    otherWrap.style.display = 'none';
    resultsSection.style.display = 'none';
    if (!selectedFile) resetUpload();
    updateTriggerLabels(true);
  }

  function closePanel() {
    uploadPanel.style.display = 'none';
    activeTrigger = null;
    resultsSection.style.display = '';
    const hasScanBlocks = results.children.length > 0;
    topTriggerWrap.style.display = hasScanBlocks ? '' : 'none';
    bottomTriggerWrap.style.display = hasScanBlocks ? '' : 'none';
    updateTriggerLabels(false);
  }

  topTriggerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openPanel('top'));
  bottomTriggerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openPanel('bottom'));

  let selectedFile = null;
  let restrictions = [];
  let scans = [];

  const dietaryLimitMsg = document.getElementById('dietaryLimitMsg');
  let limitMsgTimer = null;

  // ── Dietary tag input ────────────────────────────────────────────

  function sanitizeRestriction(raw) {
    const cleaned = raw
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z\s-]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
    return cleaned.length < 2 ? null : cleaned;
  }

  function addTag(value) {
    const tag = sanitizeRestriction(value);
    if (!tag) return;
    if (restrictions.some(t => t.toLowerCase() === tag.toLowerCase())) return;
    if (restrictions.length >= 10) {
      dietaryLimitMsg.classList.add('visible');
      clearTimeout(limitMsgTimer);
      limitMsgTimer = setTimeout(() => dietaryLimitMsg.classList.remove('visible'), 3000);
      return;
    }
    restrictions.push(tag);
    renderTags();
  }

  function removeTag(tag) {
    restrictions = restrictions.filter(t => t !== tag);
    renderTags();
  }

  function clearAllTags() {
    restrictions = [];
    renderTags();
  }

  function renderTags() {
    dietaryTags.innerHTML = restrictions.map(tag =>
      `<span class="dietary-tag">${esc(tag)}<button type="button" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tag)}">×</button></span>`
    ).join('');
    dietaryTags.querySelectorAll('.dietary-tag button').forEach((btn, i) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => removeTag(restrictions[i]));
    });
    dietaryClearAll.classList.toggle('visible', restrictions.length > 0);
    localStorage.setItem('dietaryRestrictions_' + currentUser, JSON.stringify(restrictions));
  }

  dietaryInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') {
      e.preventDefault();
      addTag(dietaryInput.value.replace(/,/g, ''));
      dietaryInput.value = '';
    }
  });

  // Also capture comma in input event for paste scenarios
  dietaryInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (dietaryInput.value.includes(',')) {
      const parts = dietaryInput.value.split(',');
      parts.slice(0, -1).forEach(p => addTag(p));
      dietaryInput.value = parts[parts.length - 1];
    }
  });

  dietaryClearAll.addEventListener('click', clearAllTags);

  function initApp() {
    // Load user-specific data
    loadReviews();
    restrictions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dietaryRestrictions_' + currentUser) || '[]');
    try { scans = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('menu_scanner_scans_' + currentUser) || '[]'); } catch { scans = []; }

    // Render persisted tags
    if (restrictions.length > 0) renderTags();

    // Restore saved scans (oldest first so newest ends up on top)
    scans.forEach(scan => renderScanBlock(scan, false));

    // Initial panel state: show panel directly if no history, else hide it
    if (scans.length === 0) {
      bottomTriggerWrap.after(uploadPanel);
      uploadPanel.style.display = '';
    } else {
      uploadPanel.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  // If session was restored at top, init immediately
  if (currentUser) initApp();

  // ── File handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function handleFile(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    const allowed = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/gif'];
    if (!allowed.includes(file.type)) {
      showError(`Unsupported file type "${file.type}". Please upload a JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF.`);
      return;
    }
    selectedFile = file;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    preview.src = url;
    previewWrap.style.display = 'block';
    dropZone.style.display = 'none';
    scanBtn.style.display = 'block';
    hideError();
  }

  function resetUpload() {
    selectedFile = null;
    dropZone.style.display = '';
    fileInput.value = '';
    preview.src = '';
    previewWrap.style.display = 'none';
    scanBtn.style.display = 'none';
    dietaryInput.value = '';
    hideError();
  }

  fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => handleFile(fileInput.files[0]));
  clearBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); resetUpload(); });
  preview.addEventListener('click', () => { if (preview.src) openLightbox(preview.src); });
  preview.style.cursor = 'pointer';

  // Keyboard activation for drop zone
  dropZone.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); fileInput.click(); }
  });

  dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.add('drag-over'); });
  dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
    if (!dropZone.contains(e.relatedTarget)) dropZone.classList.remove('drag-over');
  });
  dropZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    dropZone.classList.remove('drag-over');
    handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
  });

  // ── Scan ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  scanBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!selectedFile) return;

    setLoading(true);
    hideError();

    const messages = [
      'Analysing menu\u2026',
      'Identifying ingredients\u2026',
      'Checking allergens\u2026',
      'Almost there\u2026',
    ];
    let msgIdx = 0;
    const msgInterval = setInterval(() => {
      msgIdx = (msgIdx + 1) % messages.length;
      loaderText.textContent = messages[msgIdx];
    }, 2200);

    try {
      const activeRestrictions = [...restrictions];

      const thumbnailDataUrl = await new Promise(resolve => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
        reader.readAsDataURL(selectedFile);
      });

      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', selectedFile);
      formData.append('dietary_restrictions', JSON.stringify(activeRestrictions));

      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/scan/stage1`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });

      if (!res.ok) {
        let detail = `Server error ${res.status}`;
        try { const body = await res.json(); detail = body.detail || detail; } catch {}
        throw new Error(detail);
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      const items = data.items;

      if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
        clearInterval(msgInterval);
        setLoading(false);
        results.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No menu items could be identified in this image.</div>';
        resultsHeader.classList.add('visible');
        resultsCount.textContent = '0 items';
        return;
      }

      clearInterval(msgInterval);
      setLoading(false);
      showVerificationStep(items, activeRestrictions, thumbnailDataUrl);

    } catch (err) {
      clearInterval(msgInterval);
      setLoading(false);
      showError(err.message);
    }
  });

  // ── Verification step ──────────────────────────────────────────

  function showVerificationStep(rawItems, activeRestrictions, thumbnailDataUrl) {
    loader.classList.remove('visible');
    scanBtn.style.display = 'none';

    // Remove any existing verification panel
    const existing = uploadPanel.querySelector('.verify-panel');
    if (existing) existing.remove();

    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'verify-panel';

    const header = document.createElement('p');
    header.className = 'verify-header';
    header.textContent = 'Review extracted items before analysis \u2014 edit any names or descriptions, then confirm.';
    panel.appendChild(header);

    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.className = 'verify-list';

    rawItems.forEach((item, i) => {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'verify-row';
      row.dataset.index = i;

      const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
      deleteBtn.type = 'button';
      deleteBtn.className = 'verify-row-delete';
      deleteBtn.textContent = '\u00d7';
      deleteBtn.title = 'Remove item';
      deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (await confirmDelete('Remove this item?')) row.remove();
      });

      const nameLabel = document.createElement('label');
      nameLabel.className = 'edit-label';
      nameLabel.textContent = 'Name';

      const nameInput = document.createElement('input');
      nameInput.type = 'text';
      nameInput.className = 'dietary-input';
      nameInput.value = item.name || '';
      nameInput.placeholder = 'Item name';

      const descLabel = document.createElement('label');
      descLabel.className = 'edit-label';
      descLabel.textContent = 'Description';

      const descArea = document.createElement('textarea');
      descArea.className = 'dietary-input';
      descArea.value = item.raw_description || '';
      descArea.placeholder = 'Description (optional)';

      row.appendChild(deleteBtn);
      row.appendChild(nameLabel);
      row.appendChild(nameInput);
      row.appendChild(descLabel);
      row.appendChild(descArea);
      list.appendChild(row);
    });

    panel.appendChild(list);

    const actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'verify-actions';

    const confirmBtn = document.createElement('button');
    confirmBtn.className = 'scan-btn';
    confirmBtn.style.display = 'block';
    confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirm & Analyse';

    const cancelLink = document.createElement('button');
    cancelLink.className = 'verify-cancel';
    cancelLink.type = 'button';
    cancelLink.textContent = 'Cancel';

    actions.appendChild(confirmBtn);
    actions.appendChild(cancelLink);
    panel.appendChild(actions);

    uploadPanel.appendChild(panel);

    cancelLink.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.remove();
      resetUpload();
    });

    confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const rows = list.querySelectorAll('.verify-row');
      const verifiedItems = [];
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const name = row.querySelector('input').value.trim();
        const description = row.querySelector('textarea').value.trim();
        if (name) verifiedItems.push({ name, description });
      });

      if (verifiedItems.length === 0) return;

      confirmBtn.disabled = true;
      panel.querySelector('.verify-list').style.opacity = '.5';
      loader.classList.add('visible');
      loaderText.textContent = 'Analysing ingredients & allergens\u2026';
      hideError();

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/scan/stage2`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ items: verifiedItems, dietary_restrictions: activeRestrictions }),
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          let detail = `Server error ${res.status}`;
          try { const body = await res.json(); detail = body.detail || detail; } catch {}
          throw new Error(detail);
        }

        const data = await res.json();
        loader.classList.remove('visible');
        panel.remove();
        renderItems(data.items, activeRestrictions, thumbnailDataUrl);
        resetUpload();
        closePanel();
      } catch (err) {
        loader.classList.remove('visible');
        confirmBtn.disabled = false;
        panel.querySelector('.verify-list').style.opacity = '';
        showError(err.message);
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function renderCard(item, idx) {
    const name        = esc(item.name ?? 'Unnamed item');
    const desc        = item.description ? `<p class="item-desc">${esc(item.description)}</p>` : '';
    const visible     = (item.visible_dietary_flags || []).filter(Boolean);
    const userFlags   = (item.user_dietary_flags    || []).filter(Boolean);
    const common      = (item.common_ingredients  || []).filter(Boolean);
    const obscure     = (item.obscure_ingredient_notes || []).filter(Boolean);

    const allBadges = [
      ...visible.map(v => `<span class="badge badge-green">${esc(v)}</span>`),
      ...userFlags.map(u => `<span class="badge badge-amber">${esc(u)}</span>`),
    ].join('');
    const badges = allBadges ? `<div class="item-badges">${allBadges}</div>` : '';

    // Ingredients row
    const commonStr = common.length
      ? `<p class="item-meta"><strong>Ingredients:</strong> ${esc(common.join(', '))}</p>`
      : '';

    // Obscure notes — expandable
    let obscureHtml = '';
    if (obscure.length) {
      const listItems = obscure.map(n => `<li>${esc(n)}</li>`).join('');
      const id = `obscure-${idx}`;
      obscureHtml = `
        <button class="obscure-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="${id}">
          <span class="arr">►</span> ${obscure.length} obscure ingredient note${obscure.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
        </button>
        <ul class="obscure-list" id="${id}">${listItems}</ul>`;
    }

    return `
      <div class="item-top">
        <h2 class="item-name">${name}</h2>
        <button class="star-btn" aria-label="Review ${name}">☆</button>
        <button class="edit-btn" aria-label="Edit ${name}">✎ Edit</button>
      </div>
      ${badges}
      ${desc}
      ${commonStr}
      ${obscureHtml}`;
  }

  function wireCard(cardEl, item, idx) {
    // Wire up expandable obscure toggles
    cardEl.querySelectorAll('.obscure-toggle').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const expanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
        const list = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
        list.classList.toggle('open', !expanded);
      });
    });

    // Wire up star review button
    const starBtn = cardEl.querySelector('.star-btn');
    if (starBtn) {
      const scanBlock = cardEl.closest('.scan-block');
      const scanId = scanBlock ? scanBlock.dataset.scanId : '';
      const key = reviewKey(scanId, item.name);
      if (reviews[key]) {
        starBtn.textContent = '\u2605';
        starBtn.classList.add('has-review');
      }
      starBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openReviewModal(item, scanId, cardEl));
    }

    // Wire up edit button
    const editBtn = cardEl.querySelector('.edit-btn');
    if (editBtn) {
      editBtn.addEventListener('click', () => showEditForm(cardEl, item, idx));
    }
  }

  function showEditForm(cardEl, item, idx) {
    cardEl.innerHTML = `
      <form class="edit-form" autocomplete="off">
        <div class="edit-field">
          <label class="edit-label">Name</label>
          <input class="dietary-input" type="text" name="name" value="${esc(item.name ?? '')}" />
        </div>
        <div class="edit-field">
          <label class="edit-label">Description</label>
          <textarea class="dietary-input" name="description">${esc(item.description ?? '')}</textarea>
          <em style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-3)">Ingredients and allergens will be regenerated on save.</em>
        </div>
        <div class="edit-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="edit-save">Save</button>
          <button type="button" class="edit-cancel">Cancel</button>
          <button type="button" class="edit-delete scan-delete" aria-label="Delete item" style="margin-left:auto">🗑</button>
        </div>
      </form>`;

    cardEl.classList.add('edit-mode');

    const form = cardEl.querySelector('.edit-form');
    const saveBtn = form.querySelector('.edit-save');

    // Wire up delete button
    const editDelBtn = form.querySelector('.edit-delete');
    editDelBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!await confirmDelete('Delete this item?')) return;
      const scanBlock = cardEl.closest('.scan-block');
      cardEl.remove();
      if (scanBlock) {
        const scanId = Number(scanBlock.dataset.scanId);
        const scan = scans.find(s => s.id === scanId);
        if (scan) {
          scan.items.splice(idx, 1);
          saveScanHistory();
        }
      }
      const total = results.querySelectorAll('.item-card').length;
      resultsCount.textContent = `${total} item${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const newName = form.elements.name.value.trim() || (item.name ?? '');
      const newDesc = form.elements.description.value.trim();

      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving\u2026';

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/refine-item`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            name: newName,
            description: newDesc,
            dietary_restrictions: [...restrictions],
          }),
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          let detail = `Server error ${res.status}`;
          try { const body = await res.json(); detail = body.detail || detail; } catch {}
          throw new Error(detail);
        }

        const { item: refined } = await res.json();
        item.name                    = newName;
        item.description             = newDesc;
        item.common_ingredients      = refined.common_ingredients;
        item.obscure_ingredient_notes = refined.obscure_ingredient_notes;
        item.visible_dietary_flags   = refined.visible_dietary_flags;
        item.user_dietary_flags      = refined.user_dietary_flags;
        saveScanHistory();

        cardEl.classList.remove('edit-mode');
        cardEl.innerHTML = renderCard(item, idx);
        wireCard(cardEl, item, idx);
      } catch (err) {
        saveBtn.disabled = false;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Save';
        const actions = form.querySelector('.edit-actions');
        let errMsg = actions.querySelector('.edit-error');
        if (!errMsg) {
          errMsg = document.createElement('span');
          errMsg.className = 'edit-error';
          errMsg.style.cssText = 'font-size:.75rem;color:var(--accent)';
          actions.appendChild(errMsg);
        }
        errMsg.textContent = err.message;
      }
    });

    cardEl.querySelector('.edit-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => {
      cardEl.classList.remove('edit-mode');
      cardEl.innerHTML = renderCard(item, idx);
      wireCard(cardEl, item, idx);
    });
  }

  function saveScanHistory() {
    if (scans.length > 10) scans = scans.slice(-10);
    localStorage.setItem('menu_scanner_scans_' + currentUser, JSON.stringify(scans));
  }

  function renderScanBlock(scan, isNew) {
    resultsHeader.classList.add('visible');

    const scanBlock = document.createElement('div');
    scanBlock.className = 'scan-block';
    scanBlock.dataset.scanId = String(scan.id);

    // ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'scan-header';

    const thumb = document.createElement('img');
    thumb.className = 'scan-thumb';
    thumb.src = scan.thumbnailDataUrl || '';
    thumb.alt = 'Menu thumbnail';
    thumb.addEventListener('click', () => openLightbox(scan.thumbnailDataUrl));
    header.appendChild(thumb);

    const dateStr = new Date(scan.timestamp).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit',
    });
    if (!scan.name && scan.name !== '') scan.name = '';

    const meta = document.createElement('span');
    meta.className = 'scan-meta';
    meta.style.cursor = 'pointer';

    function renderMetaDisplay() {
      if (scan.name) {
        meta.textContent = scan.name;
        meta.style.fontStyle = '';
        meta.style.color = '';
      } else {
        meta.textContent = dateStr;
        meta.style.fontStyle = 'italic';
        meta.style.color = 'var(--ink-3)';
      }
    }
    renderMetaDisplay();

    meta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'text';
      input.value = scan.name;
      input.placeholder = dateStr;
      input.style.cssText = 'border:none;background:none;outline:none;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;color:inherit;padding:0;margin:0;width:12ch;min-width:8ch';
      meta.replaceWith(input);
      input.focus();

      function commit() {
        const val = input.value.trim();
        scan.name = val;
        saveScanHistory();
        input.replaceWith(meta);
        renderMetaDisplay();
      }
      function cancel() {
        input.replaceWith(meta);
      }

      input.addEventListener('blur', commit);
      input.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if (ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); input.removeEventListener('blur', commit); commit(); }
        if (ev.key === 'Escape') { ev.preventDefault(); input.removeEventListener('blur', commit); cancel(); }
      });
    });

    header.appendChild(meta);

    const spacer = document.createElement('span');
    spacer.style.flex = '1';
    header.appendChild(spacer);

    const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
    toggleBtn.className = 'scan-toggle';

    const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
    deleteBtn.className = 'scan-delete';
    deleteBtn.textContent = '\u00d7';
    deleteBtn.title = 'Delete scan';

    header.appendChild(toggleBtn);
    header.appendChild(deleteBtn);
    scanBlock.appendChild(header);

    // ── Body ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'scan-body';

    if (scan.activeRestrictions && scan.activeRestrictions.length > 0) {
      const pills = scan.activeRestrictions.map(r => `<span class="dietary-tag">${esc(r)}</span>`).join('');
      const summary = document.createElement('div');
      summary.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:.75rem;padding-bottom:.75rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)';
      summary.innerHTML = `<span style="display:block;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-3);margin-bottom:.35rem">Scanned with restrictions:</span>${pills}`;
      body.appendChild(summary);
    }

    scan.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const article = document.createElement('article');
      article.className = 'item-card';
      if (isNew) article.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 60}ms`;
      article.innerHTML = renderCard(item, idx);
      body.appendChild(article);
    });

    scanBlock.appendChild(body);
    results.insertBefore(scanBlock, results.firstChild);

    body.querySelectorAll('.item-card').forEach((cardEl, idx) => {
      wireCard(cardEl, scan.items[idx], idx);
    });

    const total = results.querySelectorAll('.item-card').length;
    resultsCount.textContent = `${total} item${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;

    // Show trigger buttons once results exist
    const hasScanBlocks = results.children.length > 0;
    topTriggerWrap.style.display = hasScanBlocks ? '' : 'none';
    bottomTriggerWrap.style.display = hasScanBlocks ? '' : 'none';

    // ── Collapse / expand ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    function setExpanded(expanded) {
      body.style.display = expanded ? '' : 'none';
      toggleBtn.textContent = expanded ? '\u25be Hide' : '\u25b8 Show';
    }

    if (isNew) {
      results.querySelectorAll('.scan-block').forEach(block => {
        if (block !== scanBlock) {
          const b = block.querySelector('.scan-body');
          const t = block.querySelector('.scan-toggle');
          if (b) b.style.display = 'none';
          if (t) t.textContent = '\u25b8 Show';
        }
      });
      setExpanded(true);
    } else {
      setExpanded(false);
    }

    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setExpanded(body.style.display === 'none'));

    // ── Add item ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const addBtn = document.createElement('button');
    addBtn.className = 'add-item-btn';
    addBtn.type = 'button';
    addBtn.textContent = '+ Add item';
    body.appendChild(addBtn);

    addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cardEl = document.createElement('article');
      cardEl.className = 'item-card edit-mode';
      cardEl.innerHTML = `
        <form class="edit-form" autocomplete="off">
          <div class="edit-field">
            <label class="edit-label">Name</label>
            <input class="dietary-input" type="text" name="name" placeholder="Item name" />
          </div>
          <div class="edit-field">
            <label class="edit-label">Description</label>
            <textarea class="dietary-input" name="description" placeholder="Description (optional)"></textarea>
            <em style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-3)">Ingredients and allergens will be regenerated on save.</em>
          </div>
          <div class="edit-actions">
            <button type="submit" class="edit-save">Save</button>
            <button type="button" class="edit-cancel">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </form>`;

      body.insertBefore(cardEl, addBtn);

      const form = cardEl.querySelector('.edit-form');
      const saveBtn = form.querySelector('.edit-save');

      form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const newName = form.elements.name.value.trim();
        const newDesc = form.elements.description.value.trim();
        if (!newName) { form.elements.name.focus(); return; }

        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving\u2026';

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/refine-item`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              item: { name: newName, description: newDesc },
              dietary_restrictions: scan.activeRestrictions || [],
            }),
          });

          if (!res.ok) {
            let detail = `Server error ${res.status}`;
            try { const body2 = await res.json(); detail = body2.detail || detail; } catch {}
            throw new Error(detail);
          }

          const { item: refined } = await res.json();
          refined.name = newName;
          refined.description = newDesc;

          scan.items.push(refined);
          saveScanHistory();

          const newIdx = scan.items.length - 1;
          cardEl.classList.remove('edit-mode');
          cardEl.innerHTML = renderCard(refined, newIdx);
          wireCard(cardEl, refined, newIdx);

          const total = results.querySelectorAll('.item-card').length;
          resultsCount.textContent = `${total} item${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
        } catch (err) {
          saveBtn.disabled = false;
          saveBtn.textContent = 'Save';
          const actions = form.querySelector('.edit-actions');
          let errMsg = actions.querySelector('.edit-error');
          if (!errMsg) {
            errMsg = document.createElement('span');
            errMsg.className = 'edit-error';
            errMsg.style.cssText = 'font-size:.75rem;color:var(--accent)';
            actions.appendChild(errMsg);
          }
          errMsg.textContent = err.message;
        }
      });

      cardEl.querySelector('.edit-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => cardEl.remove());
    });

    // ── Delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!await confirmDelete('Delete this entire scan?')) return;
      scanBlock.remove();
      scans = scans.filter(s => s.id !== scan.id);
      saveScanHistory();
      const remaining = results.querySelectorAll('.item-card').length;
      resultsCount.textContent = `${remaining} item${remaining !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
      if (!results.querySelector('.scan-block')) {
        resultsHeader.classList.remove('visible');
        topTriggerWrap.style.display = 'none';
        bottomTriggerWrap.style.display = 'none';
        bottomTriggerWrap.after(uploadPanel);
        uploadPanel.style.display = '';
        activeTrigger = null;
        resetUpload();
      }
    });
  }

  function renderItems(items, activeRestrictions, thumbnailDataUrl) {
    const scan = { id: Date.now(), timestamp: Date.now(), name: '', activeRestrictions, items, thumbnailDataUrl };
    scans.push(scan);
    saveScanHistory();
    renderScanBlock(scan, true);
  }

  // ── UI helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function setLoading(on) {
    scanBtn.disabled = on;
    loader.classList.toggle('visible', on);
    if (!on) loaderText.textContent = 'Analysing menu\u2026';
  }

  function showError(msg) {
    errorBanner.textContent = msg;
    errorBanner.classList.add('visible');
  }
  function hideError() {
    errorBanner.classList.remove('visible');
    errorBanner.textContent = '';
  }

  function clearResults() {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    resultsHeader.classList.remove('visible');
    resultsCount.textContent = '';
  }
